svg.title: Arrival to first selected token includes admission waiting preparation and prefill
svg.desc: Constructed server milestones are arrival zero admission two preprocessing start five end eight prefill start ten complete thirty first selection thirty two milliseconds. Adjacent intervals sum to thirty two. Starting at preprocessing reports twenty seven, starting at prefill twenty two, and prefill alone twenty. First stable text occurs at forty and local write acceptance forty five. All times are constructed not observed.
svg.text: Arrival-based first-selection time includes the waiting path
Constructed server milestones, milliseconds on one clock
Prefill start 10 → completed prefill 30 → first selection 32
Admission path + waits + preprocessing + prefill + selection
A later start hides part of the arrival-based path
Start at preprocessing: 27 ms. Start at prefill: 22 ms.
Prefill duration alone: 20 ms. None equals arrival-based 32 ms.
First stable text: 40 ms. Local write accepted: 45 ms.
Client first byte, content and token events need their own boundaries.
